en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone villa with a tower on the left and a portico with columns in the center, set on a landscaped lawn. Another long building stands to the right. Two people are visible in the foreground. The bottom margin contains printed Italian text identifying the villa and publisher, along with a circular stamp marked "M.C.T." and handwritten numbers.
